title: pdl-lint dumps a traceback for a YAML error
notes: Traceback gone as a side effect of E-BOUNDARY: `pdl_linter` already caught `PDLParseError`, so the YAML failure now arrives as the rendered E-PARSE-001 diagnostic instead of a 17-frame dump. Hygiene is 2, not 3: the `PDLYamlError:` class name is still printed and the multi-line diagnostic does not align with the linter's own five-space gutter. Both belong to the E-LINT items.
